summary_text: Investigated C-1042's disputed billing (SUP-5601/5602) using account, invoice, payment, credit, subscription-event, ticket, and policy data. Key findings recorded via record_progress: (1) The apparent 9/14 "double charge" was actually one authorization (TX-9002, capture_timeout, released 9/18, unfunded) plus one real settlement (TX-9001) for INV-2609 - not a duplicate; per POL-B-AUTH the released auth isn't refundable, so SUP-5601 agent S-22's promised $149 refund was an incorrect/unauthorized commitment needing withdrawal. (2) The $30 Deep Time Analytics add-on was validly added by admin seat U-2 per POL-B-ADD - correct, not an error, though owner may be unaware. (3) July $59.60 upgrade charge (INV-2607P) matches proration policy exactly, but its associated $19.60 unused-time credit (CR-778) remains unapplied and unflagged to the owner (owner_notified=false), violating POL-B-CRD - and SUP-5549's "no credit due" answer to the customer was incorrect. (4) INV-2602's $44 charge correctly reflects a $5 goodwill credit (CR-512) - not an error. Still need to verify
